::: {#hero-heading}

I am a plant scientist with a huge interest in soils, agroecology, ecosystem functioning and more widely, botany. I am currently doing a PhD on plant-soil interactions in novel protein crops at Wageningen University. On this website, I will share some pieces of my academic journey but also some more personal content, so if you're into sustainable agriculture, plant-soil dynamics or botanical fun facts, you might find some cool stuff here.

[Learn more about me →](about.qmd){.about-links .subtitle}

:::
